scope: Distance gait cadence, real-time repeated-position holds and actual HUD pointer routing with real solo/local sessions. Synthetic touch events, not physical-phone validation.

results.name: normal Yi gait is below ten pose changes per second and keeps real distance
20/60/120/144Hz show the same distance phase with all six hero poses
60Hz repeated coordinates at 120/144Hz never enter stop recovery while walking
snapshot holds expire in real time even if the server clock stalls or speed is 3x
actual arrival, attack, stun, pause and teleport override the short movement hold
touching buildable grass moves in both 3D and flat fallback without a build menu
explicit construction builds once from its owner wallet and returns to movement
a touch in construction mode on a path or blocked tile does not order movement
hero and existing tower selection retain priority in touch movement mode
skill targeting wins over tap or held-touch movement and construction
DOM construction markers obey movement and targeting instead of bypassing them
mixed canvas/DOM multi-touch cancels both the released tap and trailing marker click
dragging over a DOM marker cannot trigger construction on release
construction choices also reject a trailing multi-touch click before spending gold
switching touch mode cancels an already held canvas press
PC left grass click still constructs and right click still moves
local P2 keyboard still moves only P2 after P1 touch-mode changes
destroy removes every document-wide touch capture handler
